message.content: Your outfit is a solid choice for an office environment, featuring a neat blazer and skirt that create a professional silhouette. The burgundy skirt offers a rich color contrast to your khaki jacket near your face, which looks stylish rather than overwhelming. However, the milky ankle boots cut the line of your leg against your skin tone, creating a disjointed look in the lower half of your figure. To fix this and create a more cohesive column of color, you should switch to the black ankle boots instead.
